query:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM publish_jobs j
             WHERE j.owner_id = $1
               AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR j.post_id = $2)
               AND ($3::text IS NULL OR j.status = $3)
               AND ($4::uuid[] IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM deliveries d
                   WHERE d.job_id = j.id AND d.account_id = ANY($4)))
